name: pixel-art-forge
description: Constructive pixel-art tooling for higher-resolution sprites and game UI, with a measurable audit for the defects that make pixel art read as machine-made.

interface.shortDescription: Higher-res pixel art and game UI, audited
interface.longDescription: Build pixel art where every pixel is deliberate: crisp shapes instead of generated images, banded shading from a declared light, one forced feature scale, and an audit that measures the seven defects that make pixel art read as machine-made. Generates sprites, tiles and UI (panels, buttons, bars, nine-slice skins), animates from one base frame, and verifies the result.
defaultPrompt: Build a 64x64 sprite and run the audit until it passes
Generate a 320x180 game UI panel and its nine-slice skin
Tell me why my pixel art looks machine-made
